workout: Quick Fit: Arms and Core Burner

notes: Adductors and inner thighs still sore from first equestrian session (May 22) — not in readiness schema. Upper-body pull focus; no lower body work.

Heavy lower body on equestrian soreness — glutes and quads already compromised going in. Assisted Reverse Lunge substituted for Resisted Lunge. Got dizzy and nauseated mid-session, thought had a fever (no fever) — 3 days into Xyzal after doc switched from Zyrtec; dizziness consistent with antihistamine transition side effects, not GI. Pre-workout: 3 eggs, 100g egg whites, green tea, Yogi spiced vanilla tea, 20g creatine 15 min before. Energy 1 but subjective 3; lower strength score jumped 435→536.

Energy 5, felt great. Rope handle on Rotational Lift rests on lower knuckle (MCP joint) of both thumbs — went down in weight due to discomfort. Concern given bilateral hand surgery history. Consider alternative attachment for this movement.
First session using Polar H10 chest strap — Apple Watch left off due to D-Moose hooks on both wrists.
Knee strap worn (patellar tendon strap) — minimal relief, likely needs full sleeve per PT consult. Energy 5/5, best session yet on this program. No PRs flagged.

First GF1 session — new PRs across the board: Hip Thrust 110 lbs, Kickback 27 lbs, Hip Abduction 20 lbs. Unusually strong. Ankle Strap adduction: only did 2 sets (API logged 3); started 20 lbs, dropped to 15 (too many reps at 20). Next: 5 reps/side. Wore knee support brace — seemed to help. Rest fillers: clamshells 2×15/side; bent-knee calf raises 2×30s. Pre-workout: collagen + Vit C ~1hr before (Baar protocol). Ferritin at 6am, no Vit C, 2hr fast after (iron absorption protocol). Post-workout: Premier Protein shake. Sleep severely disrupted night before — woke every 15 min with heavy burping (GI distress). Shot day was Thu Jun 12 at new titrated dose 6.3mg; suspect last 2 shots were partial doses (air in pen) so may have hit a full dose after 2 weeks under-dosing. Strong performance despite this.

Energy 3 (home at 1am from Indigo Girls show). Rating 5 despite fatigue — glutes at 53% pre. Actively pushed above Smart Flex on all movements — manually added weight on top of SF bumps throughout. PRs on all 3 main movements reflect combined SF + user-directed progression. Prone SL hamstring curl: knees on bench (confirmed safer than hanging). All-time PRs: glute bridge 137 lbs, SL hamstring curl 31 lbs, bilateral hamstring curl 30 lbs. Warmup power PR at 75 lbs on bridge. Dry sweat. Tirzepatide still suppressing.

notes: Shot day (6.3mg tirzepatide). Hip thrust PRs on all 3 working sets — exceeded GF3 moderate target, beat GF1 PR of 110 lbs (new: 120 lbs). Prone bench hamstring curl: drop sets — started at 31 lbs, lowered to 27 then 25 for full ROM, working to failure. Hip flexion block not set to alternating — ended up doing 5 reps each side as a single set instead of 3×5 per side. Forgot banded lateral walk (rest block finisher not obvious). Standing bicycle: held on with one hand for balance while the other arm crunched — good movement to continue building.

Back-logged from screenshot (session wasn't captured at the time). Single-movement snack session — Barbell Hip Thrust only. New all-time PR: 146 lbs (up from 120 lbs on 6/18), flagged VOLUME PR in-app on the final set.

workout: Heavy Express — Floor Bridge + Ankle Straps
notes: Energy 2, vibes 3 — Zepbound titration side effects. Skipped the 4th movement in the session (workout listed 4 movements total) due to titration side effects; did the 3 logged. Titrating to 7.5mg dose Thursday. Glutes/hamstrings still recovering (50%) going into this session; new PRs on all 3 logged movements (glute bridge 143 lbs strength+volume, donkey kick 32 lbs strength, hamstring curl 33 lbs strength).

Energy 2, vibes 5 — First hands-on/upper-body session since the carpal tunnel + ulnar neuropathy diagnosis (Jun 12). Kept up hands-free lower body work (Grip-Free Heavy Rotation) through Jul 5, then paused ~2 weeks — ran out of steam plus a heat wave. Surgeon cleared hands Jul 17; padded wrist-support gloves arrived same day — https://a.co/d/0g614LfS — tried them today. Felt fully recovered going in (pre-readiness 100% across the board). On Bench Press (2nd/working set), trainer added a modification: hold knees up in a dead-bug-style tabletop anti-extension position during the press — noticeably harder than the standard version.

Energy 3, vibes 3. Two brand-new movements (Iso Split Squat Lift, Resisted DNS Star) — immediate PRs on first attempt, as expected for new movements. Performed Iso Split Squat Lift kneeling rather than the standard standing split-squat stance — knee-friendly modification.

Stopped ~2/3 through — real driver was grip/hand fatigue, not low energy or pain. On Barbell Single-Leg RDL, could no longer hold the bar (grip gave out) despite no pain — surgeon clearance is to lift and self-monitor, stop if it hurts, and this wasn't a pain stop. Programming lesson: starting the session with Single-Leg RDL (even kick-stand modified) was too aggressive for current hand-return status — sustained bar grip under single-leg balance demand exceeded current grip endurance. Also low energy/vibes (1/5 both) and very low pre-workout carb intake (~34g by session start) likely compounded. Assumed 100% recovered pre-workout.
